TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: Cargo.toml uses notify 8.x so Cargo.lock no longer includes the unmaintained instant transitive dependency.
build.rs tracks both Synapse legacy built-in filters and the RTK built-in filter pack for Cargo rebuilds.
Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock advance to a fresh patch version when the current package version already has a published tag that does not point at HEAD.
Dockerfile builds the release binary with cargo build --release --locked and does not use a no-op --no-default-features flag.
Dockerfile builder image is aligned with the documented Rust 1.95.0 toolchain so Cargo.lock dependencies requiring edition 2024 metadata can build.
Dockerfile copies the embedded OpenCode rules and plugin assets required by include_str! during release compilation.
Dockerfile runtime image provides a GLIBC version compatible with the Rust 1.95.0 builder output.
Dockerfile builder stage avoids unused protobuf/OpenSSL system packages after dependency-tree audit.
